map_rules.center: F160W-mass-weighted centroid of strict photometric members
map_rules.stellar_member_rule: stellarity < 0.8; positive F160W at >=5 sigma; cluster z inside BPZ 95% interval; ODDS >=0.5
map_rules.stellar_pixel_rule: distribute each selected member mass over its positive finite F160W pixels carrying that member's segmentation ID
map_rules.intracluster_light: zero in the primary map because no independently calibrated ICL product is available for all four systems
map_rules.xray_combination: reproject every Chandra level-2 central count image, divide summed sampled counts by summed exposure, 5-pixel median point-source suppression, 99.5-percent winsorization, then 40 kpc Gaussian smoothing
map_rules.xray_background: median plus two robust MAD sigmas of the smoothed rate in the 1.05-1.15 normalization-radius annulus
map_rules.gas_projection: Sigma_gas is proportional to sqrt(max(S_X-background,0) times 2*sqrt(R_norm^2-r^2)); normalize its integral inside R_norm to the published gas mass

stellar_population.interpretation: single old-population near-IR conversion shared by every cluster; sensitivity is propagated and never selected per object

gas_normalizations.derivation: invert the same Vikhlinin et al. 2009 M500-YX relation used by the paper, with M500=(7.6+/-0.4)e14 Msun, core-excised T=(9.17+/-0.48) keV, z=0.3001, M0=(5.77+/-0.20)e14 Msun, slope=0.57+/-0.03; quoted sigma includes Monte-Carlo parameter propagation and 10 percent morphology/deprojection systematic
direct published projected Chandra gas mass within 500 kpc

gas_normalizations.source: Mantz et al. 2016, Weighing the Giants V
gas_normalizations.derivation: direct published Mgas,500=(1.20+/-0.10)e14 Msun and R500=1.30+/-0.03 Mpc
direct deprojected table value Mgas(<R500)=(15.73+/-0.08)e13 Msun at R500=1541 kpc; adopted sigma adds a conservative 10 percent disturbed-cluster systematic
